text:
emma.ae: Quick heads-up — Sapphire Procurement paused their POC. They need a signed data-residency attestation + a firm pilot spend cap before legal will release the PO. Can Sec/Eng join a 20m sync today?

noah.presales: I can take it. Is there a standard attestation Legal accepts or should Sec draft a one-pager? Also clarify whether the cap should be total for 30 days or weekly.

mira.sec: We have a template to adapt: region lock, no outbound raw-data egress without approval, 90-day audit logs. Need to confirm KMS preference (BYOK vs Redwood KMS) and whether they require HSM attestation.

kai.eng: For Dedicated/VPC pilot we can provision in ~72h. On-prem would add 3+ weeks. If they require model pinning/quantization we'll want a short compatibility run against their samples.

leo.csm: Procurement insists on a hard ceiling for the 30-day pilot. Finance has to sign off on any cap. I can get the sanitized sample set from the customer and upload it.

noah.presales: Proposed draft to present: 30-day Dedicated pilot, optional BYOK, pilot cap $4,200 total or $0.0008/token overage (customer-favoring). Can Finance/Rev confirm quickly?

mira.sec: That cap is reasonable to present. Draft attestation (legal review required):

"Data Residency Attestation (draft) - All customer data processed only in region: eu-west-1. - No export of raw customer data outside the region without express customer approval. - Customer may elect BYOK or Redwood-managed keys with HSM. - Inference request audit logs retained for 90 days and available on request."

emma.ae: @tracker-bot please open an internal ticket to track approvals and owners.

tracker-bot: Created ticket SD-7714 (Sapphire POC BoardHold). Assigned: noah.presales, mira.sec, legal-team.

kai.eng: Reserving a staging Dedicated slot pending sign-off. If BYOK, please start KMS onboarding paperwork (24-48h). Recommend a 30-45min compatibility run once samples are uploaded.

leo.csm: Uploading sanitized samples to secure share now and inviting Eng/Sec.

noah.presales: Plan if Finance/legal OK: 1) Send draft attestation + pricing cap to customer today, 2) schedule 20-30m CTO/CISO call tomorrow with our execs, 3) run compatibility test once samples are in. Target: PO release by Fri EOD.

mira.sec: Legal requested this addendum: "Redwood to provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48 hours of request." Sending to Legal for final wording.

tracker-bot: SD-7714 status updated -> "awaiting legal review"

emma.ae: Thanks all — I'll ping Finance and Legal. If they sign quickly we can get exec intro same day. Keep updates in SD-7714. :thumbsup:
